extraction.text:
Neha Medankar

SUMMARY: Results-oriented Associate Project Manager with over 5 years of experience leading high-scale FinTech platform support, system integrations, and client onboarding. Proven adaptability in coordinating cross-functional engineering and vendor teams to deliver complex IT infrastructure projects on time. Expert in utilizing JIRA for end-to-end project tracking, risk mitigation, and milestone mapping. Demonstrated success in managing international payment ecosystems, product operations, and infrastructure migrations while maintaining 99.9% uptime and strict SLA compliance.

KEY SKILLS: -

 End-to-End Product Delivery  API Integration Support & Troubleshooting    Application & Technical Support  Operations & Incident Management   Transaction Processing & Issue Resolution  Reconciliation & Payment Failure Handling  Stakeholder Management

Product Operations & Analysis

Customer Onboarding & Training Cross-Functional Coordination

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Finmatrix Technology Pvt. Ltd. Nov 2023 – Present

Associate Project Manager

Lead end-to-end client onboarding and technical product implementation for B2B FinTech payment platforms (UPI, BBPS, POS, APIs), ensuring 99.9% system availability.

Bridge the gap between corporate clients and engineering teams; translate business requirements into actionable technical specifications and track items via JIRA.

Manage production releases, track issue resolution timelines, and conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to



minimize system transaction downtime. Supervise operational workflows and coordinate cross-functional Agile teams to deliver scalable software and portal enhancements.

Track and manage P1/P2 incidents and critical outages, reducing standard resolution times by 30–35%.  Strengthened corporate SLA adherence to >95% while leading a 12+ member execution team.

OTPay India (Instaape) Pvt. Ltd. (Mar 2023 – Nov 2023)

Product Operations Specialist

Managed business requirement gathering, stakeholder alignment, and deployment tracking for digital banking and payment gateway workflows.

Conducted detailed client discovery sessions to document custom business requirements for transaction



reporting and portal dashboards. Supported User Acceptance Testing (UAT) cycles by validating core business scenarios before production deployments.

Partnered closely with sales, technical support, and QA teams to manage integration timelines and milestone delivery for early-stage B2B partners.

Sec2Pay India E-Services Pvt. Ltd. Nov 2021 – Mar 2023

Production Support Engineer

Handled core product configurations, merchant onboarding, and daily transaction operations for BBPS, AEPS, DMT, UPI, and Micro-ATM (MATM) software networks.

Resolved client escalations, investigated API integration logs, and handled complex transaction payout reconciliations.

Coordinated closely with developers and designers to fix production bugs, streamline interdepartmental communication, and minimize settlement delays.

Awarded Best Employee of the Year (2022) for excellence in operational support and merchant technical management.

TECHNICAL PROJECTS

1. KYC Verification Portal (Next.js, PHP Admin, MySQL, Prisma)

Engineered real-time KYC validation, biometric authentication workflows, automated risk scoring modules, and regulatory compliance architectures.

Designed end-to-end user journeys, payment/API flows, and comprehensive technical product documentation.

2. Payout Integration Portal (React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, REST APIs)



Implemented automated vendor payout systems utilizing secure webhook-based transaction alerts Structured role-based access controls (RBAC) and detailed audit logging mechanisms to protect sensitive data.

3. Secure QR Code Platform (Next.js, PHP Admin, MySQL)

Deployed encrypted dynamic QR code generation algorithms, user authentication layers, and real- time transaction notifications.

Enabled real-time asset tracking protocols and secure access management.

TECHNICAL TOOLKIT

Management Tools: JIRA, MS Project, MS Excel, SharePoint  FinTech Platforms: UPI, BBPS, AEPS, DMT, POS, Micro-ATM (MATM)  Languages & Data: MySQL, REST APIs  Productivity: Microsoft Office 365, Cloud Solutions

ACHIEVEMENTS

Contributed to the strategic launch of the Hitachi WPOS / MATM Project (handling technical development and training), which successfully deployed nationally.

Delivered multiple critical payment gateway integrations resulting in an 80% improvement in



enterprise client satisfaction scores. Successfully onboarded, integrated, and supported over 200+ enterprise and white-label FinTech partners.

Awarded Best Employee of the Year (2022) at Sec2Pay India.

EDUCATION

B.Sc. (Computer Science) | Pune University (2020)  Diploma in Computer Engineering | Deemed University (2018)  SSC (10th) | Maharashtra Board (2015)

Languages 

English, Hindi, Marathi

Contact No: +91 9119536911 E-Mail ID: medankarneha1997@gmail.com Location- Pune
